data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Callahans Passage Erupts; The Latch Falls Silent
previous_model_summary.war_summary: The guns have opened along Callahans Passage, absent from our earlier editions: losses that ran at single figures now stand near three hundred eighty Colonial and two hundred seventy Warden in the past hour, and The Latch has gone to no-man's-land, the map's newest ruin. The Dead Lands keep their furnace, better than six hundred casualties a side in two hours with Callahan's Boot again the busiest work, while Stonecradle, flared since our last edition, has now given up ground — The Long Fast passed to Colonial hands in the small hours. Weathered Expanse remains the day's most scoured field, twenty-nine base actions with Necropolis fought over seventeen times; Fishermans Row follows at thirty-nine, though its guns ease. Tempest Island has woken again about Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate, Marban Hollow saw Mox taken by Colonials, and Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf stay restless, while Oarbreaker and Lykos Isle lie quiet. The ledger reads two hundred fifty-nine Colonial works against one hundred seventy-two Warden, with three in ruin at Callahans Passage, the Dead Lands and Godcrofts. It is the war's one-hundred-thirty-fourth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
